scope: single sequential real-fill pair at equal workload on the same machine. RSS sum is sampled, may double-count shared pages and includes idle residents. Native allocator-reported released bytes are advisory; before/after RSS observations are saved separately. Cold means new process/new circuit construction with ordinary OS/SDK disk caches unchanged, not a fresh machine or removed SDK cache. Different balances/nonces/checkpoints, network confirmation and cutoff waits remain explicit. No unmeasured throughput, general speedup or production-grade assertion.
